items.title: Sal Gutierrez Interview, 1970-01-15
items.q: he waits for Jimmy Comiskin, that's his office.

ctx.x: Alice is the band. We came up to Gontemore. Trombone player.

How are these guys? Oh, Alice Stratik. And that Johnny Patoosi. Yeah, he died too, man. You know, one time talking about old age. Even when you're young, you don't think of old age. You know. Oh, and that Johnny Patoosi. Yeah. He died too, man. You know, one time talking about old age. Jimmy, you're young, you don't think of old age. I thought Johnny was remarkable because he walked fast. He said, Johnny, how old are you? He said, I mean, you're going to get a kick out of this. I said, I'm 53. I said, man, it's…

What is this? The WPA band again in this? Yeah, the Tight Hole. Same band. Yeah. Looks like you've got about a hundred musicians, eh? Yeah. I don't know how many there are. I couldn't count. I said, man.
